meta.en: Summer School · Institut Origines (Aix-Marseille Université) & Institut de Physique du Globe de Paris (IPGP) · Marseille, France · 22–26 June 2026
meta.pt: Escola de Verão · Institut Origines (Aix-Marseille Université) & Institut de Physique du Globe de Paris (IPGP) · Marselha, França · 22–26 de junho de 2026

items.details: An interdisciplinary summer school co-organised by the Institut Origines at Aix-Marseille Université and the Origins theme of the Institut de Physique du Globe de Paris, dedicated to the formation and evolution of the inner Solar System, with a focus on terrestrial planets and the asteroid belt. Blending lectures by renowned experts with interactive roundtable discussions, the programme covered key topics such as cosmochemistry, planetary dynamics, disk processes, impacts, and surface composition, deepening the scientific context for my work on the exogenous delivery of organic matter and prebiotic chemistry.

meta.en: Course · Rencontres Exobiologiques pour Doctorants (RED) · Le Teich, France · Online · June 2026
meta.pt: Curso · Rencontres Exobiologiques pour Doctorants (RED) · Le Teich, França · Online · junho de 2026

items.details: An online edition of the RED interdisciplinary training school on the foundations of astrobiology (the study of the origin, evolution, and distribution of life in the Universe), bringing together doctoral students and young researchers from astronomy, planetology, geology, chemistry, and biology. Delivered remotely over a week of lectures and discussions (equivalent to 25 hours of training) and completed with a successful evaluation test, it broadened the scientific context for my work on prebiotic chemistry and the origin of life.

items.details: An interdisciplinary training school on the basics of astrobiology (the study of the origin, evolution, and distribution of life in the Universe), bringing together doctoral students and young researchers from astronomy, planetology, geology, chemistry, and biology. The programme combined lectures and discussions across these disciplines (equivalent to 40 hours of training), broadening the scientific context for my work on prebiotic chemistry and the origin of life.
